test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

P _ A A _ _ Z A _V _ _ A _ _
solution:
Given series: P _ A A _ _ Z A _V _ _ A _ _

Option 1) VPZZPVAP→ P __V__ A A __P__ __Z__ Z A __Z __V __P__ __V__ A __A__ __P__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) ZPVVAPVZ → P __Z__ A A __P__ __V__ Z A __V __V __A__ __P__ A __V__ __Z__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ZVPAPZAV → P **__Z__** A A __**V**__ __**P**__ Z A __**A **__V __**P**__ __**Z**__ A __**A**__ __**V**__ → (It follows the pattern of: PZAAV - PZAAV - PZAAV)

Option 4) VZAAPVPZ → P __V__ A A __Z__ __A__ Z A __A __V __P__ __V__ A __P__ __Z__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
